scope: All 94 current non-API filesystem screen templates. routes holds the 88 baseline template identities; added_routes holds six revamp template identities. Dynamic instances are not additional templates. Current source hashes, marker lines and composed UI imports were refreshed; earlier source evidence is preserved in the pre-refresh artifact. Source inventory only; no visual or security audit is implied.
marketing_absence_note: The baseline had only one marketing screen. Current marketing additions are listed separately; configurable external policies/help do not require matching local paths.

native_mobile.evidence: One root Next.js package; no Expo/RN/Capacitor/Flutter config, iOS/Android source project, manifest/service worker found in tracked source scan.
